MoveWithoutLookup.because: Move no longer looks the move up in the type's declared transitions, so a record can go to any stage.

MoveIgnoresTerminal.because: Move no longer refuses a record in a terminal stage, so a type that declares a transition out of a terminal stage lets the record leave it.

MoveSkipsRequiredFields.because: Move no longer checks the fields the transition requires, so a record can move while one of them is empty.
